title: Soft Tissue Graft Placement Using a Porcine Acellular Dermal Matrix (PADM) and Resorbable Magnesium Fixation Screws: A Case Series
authors: Tabanella, G.; Rider, P.; Rogge, S.; Tseneva, K.; Prpić, I.B.; Kačarević, Ž.P. Medicina 2025, 61, 1144.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone plus (bovine bone with hyaluronate) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “A PADM in combination with resorbable magnesium fixation screws offers a predictable and minimally invasive solution to improve peri-implant soft tissue with favourable short-term volumetric and esthetic results” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
